IncidentBot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGE fired: prometheus_scrape_missing (severity=high) for job=exporter-logs-usw2, affected shards: 12/12, symptom: metrics gap + log-ingest backlog > 2m. PagerDuty incident created: pd_inc_2026_8743.
Oncall-Eva: acked. Looking now.
Aman K: working on verifying, seeing consumer lag in kafka-ingest: topic=log-ingest-usw2, lag ~ 3.2M msgs. Could be exporter burst or network egress throttling.
Carla R: @Aman K can you paste the consumer group status?
Aman K: here: ```
GROUP           TOPIC                  PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
log-consumer-1  log-ingest-usw2        0          1241250         4532120         3290870
log-consumer-1  log-ingest-usw2        1          1229000         4520000         3291000
... (x12 partitions)
```
Oncall-Eva: ok consumer lag matches the alert. Any exporter's 5xx spikes?
Matt - infra: checking exporter fleet health... seeing a lot of 503s from exporter nodes behind NLB. NLB 5xx rate spiking ~20% in last 5m.
PagerDuty: pd_inc_2026_8743 auto-escalated to team:eng-sre after 2m no assign.
Oncall-Eva: hmm PD shows primary ack but auto-escalation happened too. The original ack may have been to the PD incident not the Slack page. We'll coordinate.
Carla R: possible hypothesis: exporter rollout pushing new image that misconfigured endpoint, causing higher latency and NLB timeouts -> backlog. Any recent deploys?
Aman K: Deploy list: ```kubectl rollout history deploy/exporter-usw2 -n metrics | tail -n 5
REVISION   UPDATED              STATUS    CHANGED BY
42         2026-03-15T09:12Z    Successful  ci-bot
43         2026-03-15T09:18Z    Successful  ci-bot
44         2026-03-15T09:23Z    InProgress  ci-bot
``` 44 looks like ongoing.
Oncall-Eva: if rollout is in progress, we should pause/rollback. Matt can we pause the rollout or scale down new pods?
Matt - infra: pausing: `kubectl rollout pause deploy/exporter-usw2 -n metrics` -> done. Also scaling new revision down: `kubectl scale deploy/exporter-usw2 --replicas=24 -n metrics` (scaled back to stable replica target)
Oncall-Eva: thanks. Recheck exporter 5xx after pause.
Matt - infra: metrics: exporter_5xx_rate dropped from 19% -> 3% in ~60s. NLB healthy now.
Aman K: consumer lag stop increasing as fast, growth rate reduced. Good.
Carla R: we should backfill the queue but also avoid further rollouts until postmortem. I'll open a ticket.
IncidentBot: Incident update: pd_inc_2026_8743 assigned to eng-sre oncall (Oncall-Eva). Severity remains high until backlog < 500k.
Oncall-Eva: rebalancing consumer: bumping consumer horizontal pods by 3 to catch up. `kubectl scale deployment/log-consumer-1 --replicas=10 -n ingest`
Aman K: started consumer scale, added throttle configs to reduce memory OOM risk. Monitoring GC and consumer CPU.
Oncall-Eva: quick checklist: 1) paused exporter rollout (done), 2) scaled consumers (done), 3) increased consumer parallelism, 4) NLB health improved, 5) notify support for potential customer impact.
Carla R: Prod support note: "We're seeing delayed logs and some metrics lag for customers in us-west-2. Ingest backlog is being processed; no data loss expected but ingestion delays up to ~10-15m may occur for some customers." Can someone post to #support?
Aman K: posting now. (posted to #support)
PagerDuty: Incident pd_inc_2026_8743 status: acknowledged by Oncall-Eva. Auto-escalation cleared.
IncidentBot: adding runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/infrastructure/runbooks/log-ingest-backlog (refer to section 3: backfill strategy).
Oncall-Eva: running backfill plan: set consumer max inflight to 500, enable faster commit windows. Monitoring throughput.
Aman K: throughput increased from 120k msgs/s -> 310k msgs/s after scale and config changes. Lag trending down.
Matt - infra: small hiccup: one node hit OOM briefly, restarted by K8s but autoscaler replaced it. Watching memory headroom.
Carla R: any customer-facing outages? Support said some customers reported delayed logs ingestion to Splunk pipelines. No total outages, just delayed ingestion.
Oncall-Eva: updating incident timeline: initial alert 1765432101 -> paused rollout 1765432165 -> consumers scaled 1765432220 -> backlog trending down 1765432350.
IncidentBot: Incident update: backlog < 1M at 1765432359, continuing to monitor.
Aman K: recommend incremental rollout hold and revert deploy 44 once backlog < 200k.
Matt - infra: agree. I'll coordinate with CI bot to revert and re-run tests.
Carla R: I'll start a post-incident ticket and assign owners for rollback verification, monitoring tweak, and runbook update.
Oncall-Eva: marking this thread as responder-handled. Will keep PD incident open until backlog < 50k and customer notify completed.
IncidentBot: pd_inc_2026_8743: resolved by user Oncall-Eva at 1765432408 (note: resolved in PD after backlog under threshold).
Carla R: thanks team. Follow-up: schedule a postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT.
Oncall-Eva: ack. :thumbsup:
